seguro.titulo: Who will pay for the repair?
seguro.subtitulo: This helps the shop prepare the right quote. You can change it later.
seguro.ajudaSinistro: If you don't have it yet, you can add it later.
seguro.ajudaFranquia: The amount you pay under your policy (optional).
seguro.dica_proprio: You pay the shop directly. Compare the quotes before choosing.
seguro.dica_nao_sei: No problem: you can add this later on the accident page.
seguro.dica_seguro_terceiro_br: The other driver's insurance pays. In that case you pay no deductible and you can choose the shop.
seguro.dica_seguro_terceiro_ee: The other driver's compulsory motor insurance (liikluskindlustus) pays. You can also open the claim with your own insurer, which handles the rest. Usually you pay nothing.
seguro.dica_seguro_proprio_br: Usually you only pay the deductible set in your policy. Check that your insurer accepts the shop you choose.
seguro.dica_seguro_proprio_ee: Casco covers your own car even when the accident was your fault. Usually you only pay the deductible (omavastutus) set in your policy.
seguro.passo_emergencia_br: If anyone is injured, call 192 (SAMU) or 193 (fire brigade). If you cannot agree or the other driver left, call 190.
seguro.passo_emergencia_ee: If anyone is injured, if you cannot agree on who was at fault, or if the other driver left, call 112.
seguro.passo_registro_br: Write down the other driver's plate, name, phone and insurer. If needed, file a police report (in many states online).
seguro.passo_registro_ee: Together with the other driver, report the accident on the digital form at avarii.lkk.ee (or on the paper form), stating who was at fault.
seguro.passo_seguro: Tell your insurer as soon as possible and note the claim number. Then add it on the accident page so the shop can see it.
seguro.passo_oficina_seguro: The shop sends the quote to the insurer, which approves it before the repair starts.
seguro.passo_proprio: Compare the quotes that come in and choose the shop.
seguro.passo_nao_sei: If you have insurance, check your policy for what is covered and the deductible. You can add this later on the accident page.
seguro.lembreteSinistro: The claim number is missing: when your insurer sends it, add it here so the shop can see it.
seguro.passo_emergencia_it: If anyone is hurt, call 112. If you cannot agree or the other driver has left, call the police on 112.
seguro.passo_registro_it: Fill in the CAI form (Constatazione Amichevole di Incidente) with the other driver, on paper or digitally, and both sign it. Send it to your insurer within 3 days.
seguro.dica_seguro_terceiro_it: The other driver's compulsory insurance (RC Auto) pays. With direct compensation (CARD) you open the claim with your own insurer, which settles with theirs.
seguro.dica_seguro_proprio_it: Comprehensive cover (kasko) pays for your car even if you were at fault. You usually pay only the excess set in your policy.
seguro.passo_emergencia_pt: If anyone is hurt, call 112. If you cannot agree or the other driver has left, call the police on 112.
seguro.passo_registro_pt: Fill in the Declaração Amigável (friendly accident report) with the other driver and both sign it. Each driver sends their copy to their insurer within 8 days.
seguro.dica_seguro_terceiro_pt: The other driver's compulsory insurance pays. If both cars are insured in Portugal, your own insurer can handle the claim (IDS system).
seguro.dica_seguro_proprio_pt: Own-damage cover pays for your car even if you were at fault. You usually pay only the excess set in your policy.
seguro.passo_emergencia_geral: If anyone is hurt, call the local emergency number (112 in Europe).
seguro.passo_registro_geral: Write down the other driver's plate, name, phone and insurer, and take photos. In Europe you can fill in the European Accident Statement, signed by both drivers, and send it to your insurer as soon as possible.
seguro.dica_seguro_terceiro_geral: The other driver's liability insurance pays for your repair. Tell your own insurer too: they can help with the claim.
seguro.dica_seguro_proprio_geral: If your policy covers damage to your own car, it pays for the repair; you usually pay the excess set in the policy.
seguro.seguroOutroPais: Is your insurance from another country?
seguro.cartaVerde: Foreign insurance (Green Card): your insurer handles the claim through its representative in {pais}. Ask your insurer or see the national bureau list:
